fusions.name: Scuffed Line
fusions.desc: Scuffs a line of musk 5 tiles long into the ground ahead of you that lasts 6 seconds. It deals 6 damage to each enemy that crosses it and slows it by 20% for 2 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Every Mile of Muck
fusions.desc: A kick with a road-fouled boot that deals 13 damage, knocks the target back 2.5 tiles, leaves it 15% easier to wound for 5 seconds and [Poisoned] for 8 seconds. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have travelled since you last used it (max 25%).

fusions.name: Plod On Regardless
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Right of Way
fusions.desc: On paved ground, your armour rises by 15%. Your other abilities come round 5% sooner.
